progress.preparing_companion: **Step 1 of 3 · Preparing your connection.** This usually takes a few seconds. No action is needed yet.
progress.approve_hub:
**Step 2 of 3 · Approve on {name}.** Connecting through {path}. An active proxy may take up to 90 seconds.

**Standalone hub:** when all four probe lights turn on, press down once on the top/display within 60 seconds.

**Grill controller:** press its dial or confirmation control when prompted.

This screen advances automatically after approval.
progress.finishing_setup: **Step 3 of 3 · Connecting to Weber Cloud · {remaining} remaining.** Physical approval is complete. No further button press is needed; this screen advances automatically.

user.title: Choose your Weber hub
user.description: Select the hub you want to add. The route shown beside it tells you which local Bluetooth adapter or active ESPHome proxy currently sees it.

no_devices.title: No Weber hub found
no_devices.description: Initial setup requires a connectable Bluetooth path, even if you plan to use Weber Cloud afterward. Fully close the Weber app and turn off Bluetooth on every phone or tablet that uses the hub. Wake the hub, keep it near Home Assistant or an active ESPHome Bluetooth proxy with a free connection slot, then search again.

confirm.title: Connect {name}
confirm.description:
Initial setup requires working internet access from Home Assistant.

Before continuing:

1. Turn off Bluetooth on your phone or tablet. In the Weber app, confirm **{name} is still online through Wi-Fi**.
2. Fully close the app and leave Bluetooth off on every phone or tablet that uses the hub.
3. Wake the hub. Home Assistant will connect through **{path}**.

Next, you will approve the connection on the physical hub. The final online check can take up to five minutes.

pairing_failed.title: Pairing did not finish
pairing_failed.description:
**{reason}**

Keep the Weber app closed and phone or tablet Bluetooth off. Wake the hub, then try again. You will be prompted to approve on the physical hub. Existing integration settings have not been changed.

cloud_preparation_failed.title: The private Weber connection could not be prepared
cloud_preparation_failed.description: Home Assistant stopped before contacting the hub, so no approval is needed yet. Confirm Home Assistant can reach the internet, then try again. The same private identity will be reused.

cloud_not_linked.title: The hub is paired, but Weber Cloud has not linked it
cloud_not_linked.description: Local pairing succeeded. Home Assistant reached Weber Cloud and checked automatically for up to five minutes, but the new connection was not given access to this hub. You do not need to approve the hub again. Turn off phone or tablet Bluetooth and confirm the hub is online in the Weber app; if it is offline there too, restore the hub's Wi-Fi before checking again.

menu_options.retry_cloud: Check Weber Cloud again — up to 5 minutes

cloud_unavailable.title: Weber Cloud could not be reached
cloud_unavailable.description: Local pairing succeeded, but Home Assistant could not complete the online check. The hub does not need approval again. Confirm Home Assistant has internet access. With phone or tablet Bluetooth off, also confirm the hub is online in the Weber app; if it is offline there too, restore the hub's Wi-Fi. Then try again.

menu_options.retry_cloud: Try the online check again — up to 5 minutes

setup_failed.title: Setup did not finish
setup_failed.description: Setup could not finish. Existing integration settings have not been changed. Check the Home Assistant logs for the cause, then start over.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect {name}
reauth_confirm.description: Pair a new private connection with this same hub. Your device, entity IDs, probe names, dashboards, and automations will be kept. The current configuration stays in place until pairing and the Weber Cloud check both succeed.

create_entry.default: **Both setup steps are complete.** Turn Bluetooth back on and reopen the Weber app. The phone may use the hub's Bluetooth connection while Home Assistant continues receiving cook data online.

abort.already_configured: This Weber hub is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup is already open for this Weber hub. Close this window and continue the existing setup.
abort.reauth_successful: Connection replaced. Turn Bluetooth back on and reopen the Weber app. Your existing device and entities have been kept.
abort.wrong_hub: The paired appliance does not match this integration. Nothing was changed. Retry with the original hub.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Connection replaced. Turn Bluetooth back on and reopen the Weber app. Your existing device and entities have been kept.

init.title: Weber Connect settings
init.description: Give each probe a food name, such as Brisket. Its physical probe number stays visible. Home Assistant receives readings through Weber Cloud while you continue using the Weber app.

probes.name: Probe names
probes.description: Optional nicknames appear beside the permanent probe number.

confirm.title: Pair {name} again
confirm.description: Weber rejected the private connection for {name}. Continue to start pairing recovery, then open the integration’s reauthentication prompt in Devices & services. Approve the replacement connection on the same physical hub. Your existing device, entity IDs, names, dashboards, and automations will be kept.
